parent_objective: Evaluate P6 coupled finite-horizon stability and rollback against actual compiled HLA/HLB execution

p6_model.native_observation: mean native u at levels 1 and 2
p6_model.control_injection: accepted_operator @ p6_state added to first two coordinates of the level-2 context feature
p6_model.control_timing: one-tick feedback; current P6 state controls this tick, native output updates P6 state for the next tick

candidate_lifecycle.promotion: existing CandidateRevision independent validation; identifiable and validation improvement greater than 1e-8
rollback_sequence: execute the same 20-step input sequence under candidate
exercise P6 model-level rollback to the prior operator
replay the 20-step incumbent sequence and require exact checkpoint fingerprint equality

native_runtime.native_state_claim: report finite-state status and observed maximum norm; no post-hoc native-state threshold

independent_seed_policy: P6 runtime seeds are separate from H1 train/validation/confirmatory seeds
claim_boundary: finite-horizon closed-loop execution for the declared HLA/HLB native runtime configuration
not proof for other native kernels, timesteps, dimensions or input bounds
